say:1:1035510001:1.text: It's all because of him and his infernal training! Just look at how ragged we look!
say:1:1035510001:1.source_cn: 谁让他天天搞那些魔鬼训练！你看看我们几个被他折磨成什么样了！
say:1:1035510001:1.male: It's all because of him and his infernal training! Just look at how ragged we look!
say:1:1035510001:1.female: It's all because of him and his infernal training! Just look at how ragged we look!

say:2:1035510002:1.text: We weren't that strong to begin with, but thanks to Shakir, our bodies are completely wrecked now!
say:2:1035510002:1.source_cn: 我们哥几个身子骨本来就不是很硬朗，现在好了，彻底被他训...
